ui_bugs.issue: When POST /api/rf/sessions returns 500 with body {"detail":"boom"}, the round screen's rf-error renders the raw backend detail ('boom') instead of a friendly message. Expected: generic 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' or similar. Repro: page.route('**/api/rf/sessions*', fulfill status=500 body {detail:boom}), tap REPLAY on any weak row. Screenshot: /app/test_reports/artifacts_iter119/c25_500.jpeg. Suggested fix: in the session fetch error handler map any non-network server error to a fixed friendly string and keep the detail only in console/log.

When GET /api/rf/revision fails on a cold load, the lobby does not render rf-weak-cards-badge at all (selector times out), while the lobby still shows other tiles. Expected: either render the badge as '—' / '!' or keep the sticker with a known-last value so the lobby does not silently drop a key testID. Screenshot: /app/test_reports/artifacts_iter119/c24_lobby_fail.jpeg. Low-impact because the sheet below still opens and shows rf-revision-error with Retry; still worth a fix so testers/users do not see a blank sticker area.

LOW: LobbyTab.tsx rf-weak-cards-badge should still render (perhaps as '—' or using a stale cache) when GET /api/rf/revision fails on a cold load; today the testID is simply absent until data arrives. rca_of_issue: C2.5 bug — rf-error renders raw backend detail: Repro — page.route('**/api/rf/sessions*', fulfill status=500 body='{"detail":"boom"}'), tap REPLAY on any rf-revise-chapter row. Expected: rf-error shows a friendly message and a Retry button. Actual: rf-error shows literally 'boom\nRetry'. Root cause: the session fetch error handler (session.tsx uses `error` state wired to ErrorBox) passes through the api client's error.message which is derived from the server-provided `detail`. Fix candidates: in /app/frontend/src/api/client.ts intercept non-2xx POSTs and replace message with a context-aware string ('We couldn't start that round. Please try again.'); OR in session.tsx map the caught error to a friendly label before setError. Keep the raw detail only in console/log for debugging. Minor side-note in C2.4: rf-weak-cards-badge is absent (not rendered) while GET /api/rf/revision* is aborted on a cold load. The lobby strip rf-weak-sprint already has a 'Finding your weak subtopics…' placeholder; the chapter badge sticker should follow the same pattern so the testID keeps existing (improves testability and avoids a blank sticker frame).
